question: Food establishment has an updated FSSAI license and is displayed at a prominent location.
Premise is located in area that is free from objectionable odour, smoke, dust & other contaminants.
The design of food premises provides adequate working space; permit maintenance & cleaning.
Internal structure & fittings are made of non-toxic, impermeable materials which prevent the entry of dirt, dust & pest.
The premise is well equipped with chilling room, freezing room, freezer store or freezer as per the operations and fitted with temperature measuring or recording devices.
Floors are non-slippery, non-toxic, impervious & sloped appropriately.
Walls are non-absorbent, non-toxic, preferably light coloured, smooth & without crevices.
Ceilings are free from accumulated dirt, mould development & flaking paint or plaster.
Windows & other openings are free from accumulated dirt, those which open are fitted with insect-proof screen.
Doors are smooth, non-absorbent surface, close fitted & self closing (where appropriate).
Premises have sufficient lighting i.e. 540 lux (inspection points), 220 lux (work room) & 110 lux (other areas).
Adequate ventilation is provided within the premises.
Potable water (meeting standards of IS:10500 & tested semi annually with records maintained thereof) is used as product ingredient or in contact with food (ice & steam) or food contact surface.
Facilities for cleaning & disinfection of implements are made of non corrosive material & fitted with suitable means of supplying hot water in sufficient quantity.
Equipment, utensils and containers is made of material that is non-toxic, impervious, non-corrosive, facilitate cleaning & do not provide harbourage to pests.
Food material is tested either through internal laboratory or an accredited lab. Check for records.
Personnel hygiene facilities are available including toilets, hand washing facilities with warm/hot and cold water, hygienic drying, adjacent to toilets and processing area entry.
Premise has facility for storage of waste & inedible material such that contamination with food is avoided and is free from pest activity.
Incoming material procured as per internally laid down specification from approved vendors. Check for records (specifications, supplier details, batch no., quantity procured).
Raw materials inspected at the time of receiving for food safety hazards.
Incoming material, semi or final products stored according to their temperature and humidity requirement, in a hygienic environment. FIFO & FEFO is practised.
The temperature in room for boning out & trimming are controlled & held suitably low, unless cleaning of equipment & utensils are carried out at least every four hours.
Room used for deboning, preparing, packing or handling of meat is equipped with adequate facilities for cleaning & disinfecting implements (knives, cleavers, saws) not used for other purposes.
Meat shall be processed and packed using sound food grade materials in a hygienic manner.
Containers used for storing inedible substances, cleaning chemicals & other hazardous substance are clearly identified; stored separately from food.
Transporting vehicle for food use are kept clean and maintained in good repair.
Transporting vehicle capable of meeting requisite temperature (where applicable).
Recalled products are held under supervision & destroyed or reprocessed/reworked in a manner to ensure their safety. Check for records.

All equipments, implements, tables, utensils (knives, cleavers, saws, containers) cleaned & disinfected at frequent intervals, immediately after contact with infected material, and at end of work day.
Preventive maintenance of equipment and machinery are carried out regularly as per instructions of manufacturer.
Measuring & monitoring devices are calibrated periodically.
Pest control program is available & pest control activities are carried out by trained and experienced personnel. Check for records.
No signs of pest activity or infestation in premises.
Waste is removed from meat handling area at regular intervals (at least daily) & receptacles are cleaned & disinfected.
Drains are designed to meet expected flow loads and equipped with traps to capture contaminants.
Disposal of sewage and effluents is done in conformity with standards laid down under Environment Protection Act, 1986 (BOD is less than 1500).
Annual medical examination & inoculation of food handlers against enteric group of diseases as per recommended vaccine schedule is done. Check for records.
No person suffering from a disease or illness or with open wounds or burns is involved in handling of food or materials which come in contact with food.
Food handlers maintain personal cleanliness (clean clothes, trimmed nails & waterproof bandage) and personal behaviour (hand washing, no loose jewellery, no smoking, spitting etc).
Food handlers equipped with suitable aprons, gloves, headgear, shoe cover etc.
Internal / External audit of the system is done periodically. Check for records.
Food Business has an effective consumer complaints redressal mechanism.
Food handlers have the necessary knowledge and skills & trained to handle food safely. Check for training records.
Appropriate documentation & records are available and retained for a period of one year or shelf-life of product, whichever is more.
